name: Theme generator
description: Pick an image from your wallpapers or from Wallhaven (haseen wallhaven search/get, SFW), a matugen scheme and dark or light; preview the palette on a mock desktop, then Save it as a theme or Apply it (haseen theme generate)

directories.description: Directories to scan for images; ~ and $HOME expand, missing ones are skipped

depth.description: How many directory levels of each entry to scan

limit.description: Most images listed; a larger find result is cut and the count said

columns.description: Thumbnails in a row: shown at once in the image strip, and the Wallhaven grid's columns

placement.description: Where the panel opens: center (the middle of the screen) or bar (a panel under the bar)

scheme.description: Scheme selected when the panel opens (tonal-spot, content, expressive, fidelity, fruit-salad, monochrome, neutral, rainbow, vibrant)

source.description: Image source when the panel opens: local (your wallpaper directories) or wallhaven (wallhaven.cc search, SFW unless you keep an API key in ~/.config/haseen/wallhaven.key)

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.themegen to drive the open panel without a keyboard
